result.title: 3DCodeFactory: Scaling Training Data for 3D Code Agents
result.summary: As code agents evolve, their scope is expanding from generating simple static 3D meshes to constructing structurally complete, complex, interactive 3D scenes. However, existing datasets mainly rely on converting or captioning pre-existing 3D assets, consisting mostly of single-turn code data for static single objects and struggling to scale task diversity and scene complexity, leaving such training data scarce. We present 3DCodeFactory, an automated framework that directly constructs diverse, complex 3D training data from abundant raw text (e.g., diffusion prompts and product descriptions). The framework first leverages an image generator to synthesize 3D reference images from raw text as visual anchors, guiding the generation of concrete modeling specifications and interactive functional requirements; meanwhile, it jointly constructs visual, specification, and functional rubrics from the reference images and requirements to automatically score and filter multi-turn agent rollouts. Based on this framework, we release 3DCodeFactory-Data, comprising 5,045 high-quality task instances and multi-turn interaction trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B on 3DCodeFactory-Data significantly improves performance on BlenderWorld, P3D-Bench, and 3DCodeBench, consistently outperforming models trained on existing open-source 3D code datasets, with our 27B model further surpassing the same-series 2.4T flagship Qwen3.8-Max in overall performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 3DCodeFactory 框架：从原始文本经图像生成器合成 3D 参考图作为视觉锚点，据此产出建模规格与交互功能需求，并联合构建视觉、规格、功能三类 rubric 自动评分筛选多轮 agent 轨迹，发布 5,045 条任务实例与轨迹数据，微调 Qwen 系列模型后在多个 3D 代码基准上优于既有开源数据训练的模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 用合成参考图作视觉锚点、并以视觉 rubric 对多轮 rollout 打分筛选，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与轨迹级贡献分配提供可核查线索；但该工作面向 3D 代码生成数据规模化，不涉及内部 latent 推理状态。
